cancel.confirmDraft: This draft is cancelled directly. No cancellation invoice is created, because a draft is not a document; no gap appears in the invoice number sequence.
cancel.confirmStorno: The original invoice is preserved in full. In addition a cancellation invoice with its own number and negative amounts is issued, so both documents net to zero.
cancel.auditNote: The reason is recorded in the audit trail.

storno.cancelsPrefix: This cancellation invoice reverses another invoice.
storno.cancelledByPrefix: This invoice was reversed by a cancellation invoice.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.description: Append-only trail per GoBD: who, when and what — entries are never changed or deleted.
audit.limitNote: Draft edits are not recorded (a draft is not a document); partial payments appear as a payment entry.

reports.subtitle: Revenue, occupancy, ADR and RevPAR over time.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.subtitle: Taken from finalized invoices (accrual basis). Drafts are not counted; a cancelled invoice and its cancellation invoice are both counted and net to zero.

empty.title: No revenue in this period
empty.description: There is no finalized invoice in the selected period.

excluded.title: Not included in total revenue
excluded.accountingTotal: Accounting total (total revenue + unallocatable revenue, net):

cityTax.label: City tax (collected)
cityTax.hint: Not revenue: a pass-through item collected on behalf of the municipality. Excluded from total revenue and from ADR.

unbilled.label: Not yet invoiced (gross)
unbilled.hint: Stays without a finalized invoice. Purely an operational comparison figure — it feeds into no total.

other.label: Unallocatable revenue (net)
other.hint: Manual invoices and invoices tied to cancelled or no-show reservations. They cannot be assigned to a room night, so they are excluded from total revenue and from ADR.

channels.caption: Revenue by booking channel
channels.zeroNote: A channel showing 0.00 is normal: a finalized invoice and its cancellation invoice are both counted and cancel out exactly. The row is deliberately not hidden.
